senses.gloss: m. pl. (πάγχρυσος) [all-gold,] name of a fruit, prob. apricots.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 1:8:8">Y. Sot. I, 17ᵇ</cite> top <he>יפה מפ׳ וכ׳ …</he> better were the late fruits … than the apricots &c.; ib. IX, 24ᵇ bot.; (<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 7:3:9">Y. Peah VII, 20ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>מפרסקין</he>).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 3:1:11">Y. Sabb. III, 5ᵈ</cite> <he>וטעמן יפה כפ׳</he> and their taste was as delicious as that of apricots; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 2:1:20">Y. Ter. II, 41ᶜ</cite> bot. (corr. acc.).—Y. Ab. Zar. II, 41ᵈ <he>פ׳ … שלהן</he> apricots pressed by gentiles (prob. to be read, as Bab.

<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 38b">Ab. Zar. 38ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 4:11">Tosef. ib. IV</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 5:11">V</cite>), 11 <cite ref="S01772"><he>קַפְרִיסִין</he></cite>).
